corrections.defect: Two of the four cited numbers are the MUTATED COPY's lines, and neither the sentence nor the file says so: the two arms whose mutant deleted three lines above the assertion — admin_routers and quiescence — print :67 and :1591, which are lines of the /tmp/mut copy, not of the tree. The quiescence number in particular cannot be read as a tree line — tree tests/unit/test_deployment_quiescence.py:1591 is the first line of the removed in-body skip (tree :1591-1593) and the kthreadd assertion is at :1594; the document's own arms[quiescence_kthread].fail_line at .skip-inventory.json:2891 prints the mutated path /tmp/mut/tests/unit/test_deployment_quiescence.py:1591, and revision 3's change-list entry at :3110 repeats the numbers 'as the retained arm logs print them', which is true of the logs and silent about the copy. The other two numbers are the SAME line in both copies: tests/unit/test_novel_model_routes.py:44 (the novelty assertion, inside the helper _assert_specialized_alias_parity, def at :41) and tests/integration/test_owned_coding_shell.py:357 (the exact-source-identity assertion) have no deleted line above them, so they coincide with the tree and need no pair. A tree reader who follows admin :67 lands on the test's def line (the removed skip decorator is tree :63-65; the assertion is tree :70), and one who follows quiescence :1591 lands on a skip guard, not on any assertion.
